committee: *PRESENTATION for Certificate 298-38 (COR) - Senator Vincent A.V. Borja
title: Håfa Adai! Please be advised that on Monday, February 9, 2026, at 11:30 AM at Adacao Elementary School. Senator Vincent A.V. Borja will present Certificate 298-38 (COR), in recognition of individuals for their dedication and contributions to maintaining a healthy and safe environment for students and staff; and to commend them for their efforts in achieving an ‘A’ sanitation rating during the Department of Public Health and Social Services inspection held on January 6, 2026, at Adacao Elementary School. We look forward to your attendance and participation. 2/06/2026 9:15 A.M. (FN)
